description: This file implements symbolic FX operators for representing arbitrary ONNX operators, including classes and functions for encoding attributes, creating symbolic operations, and registering custom ONNX symbolic operators with fake and real implementations.

classes.name: EncodedAttrs
classes.description: Class to encode attributes from dictionary into lists of FX compatible attributes, supporting conversion to and from dictionary form for ONNX node creation.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Creates an EncodedAttrs instance from a dictionary of attributes, encoding various types into FX-compatible lists.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Converts an EncodedAttrs instance back into a dictionary suitable for creating an ONNX node.
